findings.title: SYMMETRY withheld only after a real liveness counter-example
what_happened: The configuration checks PROPERTIES SimpleAllocator; the root module only defines SimpleAllocator == Simple!SimpleAllocator, so the first version of the liveness detector looked at a body with no temporal operator and concluded 'safety shaped'.
SymView therefore emitted SYMMETRY and the reduced run reported a temporal violation while the unreduced run was clean.

symmetry_error_lines: Error: The following behavior constitutes a counter-example:

findings.root_cause: liveness detection stopped at the syntactic body and did not follow INSTANCE/bang-path references into the module that holds the temporal property.
findings.fix: analysis/program.py::_scan_temporal follows calls and Alias!Op references (depth <= 4, visited set); an unresolvable checked property is treated as a liveness risk. Regression test: tests/test_liveness_guard.py.
findings.classification: tool bug (unsound suggestion), not a defect of the reduction theory
